environment: kind v0.24.0 single node on Docker Desktop; deploy/k8s-testing overlay (2 API replicas, 1 vCPU / 512Mi limits, in-cluster mock LLM 400ms +/-20%)
traffic: scripts/load_test.py from an in-cluster pod: 10 closed-loop clients, one keep-alive connection each, 1500 requests per run
change_under_test: preStop drain: the hook creates DRAIN_FILE, the API answers every request with Connection: close and /readyz 503 for 10s before SIGTERM (previously a plain 5s sleep). Motivated by one CI rollout run that dropped requests on a GitHub runner; the drop did not reproduce locally in 4 runs (6000 requests) before the change.

rollout.disruption: kubectl rollout restart (maxUnavailable 0, preStop drain 10s), 3 runs
